description: This Java class implements a command handler for deleting entity-to-entity mappings within the Fineract platform. It processes delete commands annotated with @CommandType, leveraging the FineractEntityAccessWriteService to perform the delete operation.

classes.name: DeleteEntityToEntityMappingCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class annotated with @Service that handles delete commands for entity mappings, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command by invoking the deleteEntityToEntityMapping method on the FineractEntityAccessWriteService with the entity ID extracted from the JsonCommand.
